verdict.rationale: Netlify's own documentation states it can roll back any deploy in one click, which matches the story's 'any previous version' and 'one click' elements directly. The support is a single marketing line with no detailed docs or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party rollback docs (scope, retention of old deploys, function/env handling) and independent or hands-on corroboration that rollback works as claimed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can roll back a deployed service to any previous version in one click

citations.quote: Roll back any deploy in one click
